system.inverter: Aurora Power One 6 kW grid-tie inverter
system.measurement_point: certification system output; report names interface and inverter but does not provide a separate meter-point diagram
system.rotor_diameter_basis: derived from reported 23.7 m2 swept area; confirm against manufacturer drawing before engineering use

power_curve_units.source_table_header_note: source PDF labels output kW but listed values are watt-scale system output; values are retained as W

validity.outside_range_policy: return 0 W with an explicit unsupported-range flag; this is a conservative scenario policy, not a claim that the turbine physically shuts down
validity.negative_curve_policy: clip negative auxiliary-system values to 0 W and record the count
validity.density_correction: none; curve is the certified system output at reference density 1.225 kg/m3 and no extra inverter loss is applied

adaptation.wind_timestamp_semantics: instantaneous wind value at normalized interval start; no radiation midpoint shift
adaptation.losses: no unsupported availability or electrical loss is applied by default; user may provide an explicit availability factor
adaptation.site_conditions: ground/site, setback, obstacles, turbulence and grid connection remain unverified inputs

licenses_and_limits: Public official certification report URL and extracted curve metadata are cited for research comparison. Raw PDF is kept locally for provenance but is not redistributed in the result package; verify publisher terms before external distribution. This is not a procurement or engineering approval.
